name: Barrington Wood Works LLC
old_description: Barrington Wood Works established in April 2018. We have several years of experience in the Custom Millwork Industry.  We work with clients, designers and architects directly, creating shop drawings for any project that is needed with the most professional level of finish.
about:
Barrington Wood Works LLC was established in April 2018 in Lake Barrington, Illinois. The company operates from its Lake Barrington facility where it handles fabrication and finishing for custom millwork projects.

The shop provides custom millwork design, shop drawings, CNC machining, factory finishing, millwork fabrication, installation, and field touch‑up services. It also offers semi‑custom cabinetry and pre‑installs projects to simplify final installation. All fabrication and finishing are performed in‑house at the Lake Barrington location.

The company serves residential and commercial clients across the Greater Chicagoland area, working directly with property owners, designers, and architects. Its project portfolio includes custom millwork for homes and commercial spaces in communities such as Arlington Heights, Barrington, Lake Forest, and Naperville.

Barrington Wood Works emphasizes high‑quality craftsmanship and materials coupled with quick turnaround times. The business was founded to deliver professional‑level shop drawings and finish work for any custom millwork project, positioning itself as a direct partner for design professionals and property owners.
